statement: Hourly clicking of alchemy bubbles is a sweaty mechanic requiring very active play for long hours, which most people ignore.
Once printer prints 1 billion materials per hour, set specific prints to level a bubble once per hour since bubble material cost caps at 1 billion.
Prioritize linear bubbles that give the same amount each level, which can reach tens of thousands of levels, despite diminishing returns on others.
Roid Raging, Swift Stepping and Stable Genius are linear bubbles needing oak logs, bleach logs and copper ore, which are easy to get.
Easiest materials like oak logs bleach logs and copper ore can be printed in billions in the 3D printer.
Stack Larry with printing: gives times two, with potential times three chance if above 100%.
Playing 10 hours a day and clicking every hour gives a minimum of 20 bubble levels per day per bubble.
Elephant god from Divinity has a chance to proc the 3D printer so AFK time counts as print time, giving hundreds of bubble levels a day if active.
End gamers sit on bubonic conjuror with Cranium Cooking to keep liquids high and click the bubbles.
In endgame move on to stronger bubbles for hourly clicking like Hardy Diggy, Larry or Call Me Bob.
20-minute traps are even sweatier than hourly clicking.
Speaker sets 40-hour and 20-hour traps and uses the rift vacuum; casual way of doing traps.
A 20-minute trap gives the same shiny critter amount as a 60-hour trap; there is no difference in shiny chance by duration.
Only the Shiny Snitch prayer changes shiny chance giving more quantity but with a shiny catch reduction rate.
Set up 20-minute traps and use timers or Idleon Toolbox, whose dashboard has all the timers.
20-minute traps give the most critters per claim; longer trap duration yields fewer critters overall; about 30 checks in a 10-hour day gives lots of critters and shinies.
Two-minute claims are almost a must in certain scenarios; most people will have to do it at some point unless they want to wait months.
Archer talent Smelting Every Day has a chance per kill to add smelting progress including multi-kill; around 2 million kills at green mushroom map likely hits forge cap.
Forge cap means ore in the forge only makes those bars from one AFK claim before refilling, thanks to the automation arm.
Using 1-hour time candies makes no difference versus 72-hour candy once the kill cap is hit.
Double Siege Breaker meta becomes better than double Blood Berserker in late game with two Siege Breakers and one Hunter.
Park all three archers at gush to farm money percent for fungi finger pocketeer in the lab while cycling 2-minute claims for forge progress.
Cycling 2-minute claims across archers is the feasible way to get multiple God Shard tools, armors and weapons; bars are very expensive.
Two minutes is the minimum time needed to claim AFK gains.
Depending on forge, about 30 to 40 God Shard bars per forge slot per 2-minute claim; a weapon needs around 150k God Shard bars.
This works with any bar.
This is why double Siege Breaker is the play; going into world 8 Siege Breaker may become even more potent if it stays like this.
MP and HP snapshotting for 3D prints is not as demanding as others but is the biggest chore, very important.
Do an MP snapshot for chopping and an HP snapshot for mining because of Hardy Diggy and Hocus Jus.
MP snapshot gives about 2 percent increase while HP snapshot gives 2 to 11 percent depending on game progress.
Speaker no longer does snapshotting because it needs two full gear sets.
Needs efficiency and AFK gain gear for printing plus a second set for snapshots including cards, card sets, star signs, equipment, keychains and food.
Load into the zone with HP snapshot gear, do a quick refresh in alchemy and open it, close alchemy to snapshot the gear.
After snapshot, equip efficiency gear and do the 3D print sample; repeat for each map change or jump shop and each next material.
Gaming is slow until world 6 farming; crop depot bonus with about 120+ crops increases gaming evolution chance, actually gaming speed.
With 120+ crops while running Kitsune, plants respawn on a 5-second interval so you can spam harvest all.
Sitting in world 5 town turns the 5-second plant respawn interval into 1 second because it refreshes faster there.
Isotope Discovery super bit for 90q red bits gives bonuses plus 10, so boron bubbles go to 70 instead of 50, an extra 40 bubbles a day.
Extra 40 alchemy bubbles a day is significant with Larry procs.
Real sweat is getting chemical plants fast, the time candies of gaming, which refresh shovel and increase nugget sizes.
Extreme players do 1-second intervals to get millions of golden nuggets and purple bits, a tier above red bits, requiring constant attention; gaming not finished yet.
Alchemy is the most important mechanic; candy the first bubbles.
Use time candy to gather billions of resources, put in inventory, move to storage using ram companion access, then level alchemy bubbles.
End gamers run full carry capacity with rucksack sacrificing AFK gains to load inventory with resources for bubble leveling.
If out of water, swap to bubonic conjuror, do Cranium Cooking, then return and spam more levels.
Endgame players use candy only on this and dump the rest on fractal island.
On map change, materials over a billion and 50 million in storage are taken out and converted to atoms; keeping them in inventory avoids this.
Rucksack and carry capacity are important to keep materials in inventory.
New update with land rings made the Night Market very strong.
Glassy, final seat of farming, is on 4-second cycles; endgamers may reach 1-second cycles eventually.
Get each crop to 100K for night market bonuses: farming speed, XP, crop evolution, and 100K bonus boosting all other night market bonuses by percentage.
Sit at farming and farm millions of beans to juice up the night market and day market.
One Night Market bonus increasing crop number isn't working yet; when it works, crops worth 2e35 and more babysitting required.
You don't need to do any of this; it helps tremendously, but the video shows what is possible at that level.
Joking that the nothing trophy isn't hard; the speaker is third on leaderboard and doesn't have it yet.
